ValidationRule.description: Make Approval Submission Date mandatory while Legal approval is required
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISPICKVAL( Legal_Approval__c , 'Required'), OR(ISNULL( Approval_Submission_Date__c ), Approval_Submission_Date__c > TODAY()) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Approval Submission Date cannot be a future date or null, please verify.
